from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingStartRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single housing starts data point extracted from a report."""
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data applies to, format YYYY-MM")
    saar_value: float | None = Field(description="The SAAR value recorded in the report")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the value, e.g., 'thousands' or 'units'")
    release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report containing this data was released, format YYYY-MM-DD")
    source_doc_id: str | None = Field(description="A unique identifier for the source document, e.g. 'Document_1'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_start_records: list[HousingStartRecord]
